units.source_text: 只有对薰中纳言的回信，因为对方态度非常诚恳，故这边也不疏懒。

en.t: Only in replying to Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, did they not neglect their duty, because his manner was so very sincere.

units.source_text: 双方常有书信往还。

en.t: Letters often passed back and forth between them.

units.source_text: 八亲王断七之后，薰君亲自来访。

en.t: After the seventh-day rites for the Eighth Prince were completed, Lord Kaoru came to visit in person.

units.source_text: 两女公子住在东室较低的一个房间里守孝。

en.t: The two princesses were observing mourning in a lower room of the eastern chambers.

units.source_text: 薰君走到房间旁边，召唤老侍女弁君来前。

en.t: Lord Kaoru went to the side of the room and summoned the elderly gentlewoman Ben no Kimi before him.

units.source_text: 这愁云密布、暗淡无光的山庄中，突然进来一个英姿焕发、光彩夺人的贵人，

en.t: Into this mountain villa, dark and lightless under clouds of grief, there suddenly entered a nobleman of brilliant bearing and dazzling grace,

units.source_text: 使得两女公子局促不安，答话也说不出来。

en.t: so that the two princesses became uneasy and constrained, unable even to answer him.

units.source_text: 薰君说道：“对我请勿如此疏远。

en.t: Lord Kaoru said, "Please do not keep me at such a distance.

units.source_text: 应照亲王在日那样互相亲信，方可彼此晤谈。

en.t: Only if we trust one another as we did while the Prince was alive can we speak together properly.

units.source_text: 我不惯于花言巧语的风情行为。

en.t: I am not accustomed to romantic conduct dressed up in sweet words.

units.source_text: 叫人传言，使我话也不大说得出来。”

en.t: When I must send messages through others, I can hardly say what I wish."

units.source_text: 大女公子答道：“我等苟延残喘，直至今日，真乃意外之事。

en.t: The elder princess replied, "That we have somehow dragged out our lives until today is truly more than we expected.

units.source_text: 然而心常失迷于永无醒期的乱梦中。

en.t: Yet our hearts are always lost in a confused dream from which there seems no waking.

units.source_text: 仰望日月之光，也不知不觉地感到羞耻。

en.t: Even when we look up at the light of the sun and moon, we find ourselves feeling ashamed without knowing why.

units.source_text: 故窗前也不敢走近去。”

en.t: For that reason we do not even dare to approach the window."

units.source_text: 薰君说道：“这也太过分了。

en.t: Lord Kaoru said, "That is going too far.

units.source_text: 居丧恭谨，确是出于一片深情。

en.t: Your reverent restraint in mourning surely comes from deep feeling.

units.source_text: 至于日月之光，倘是自心贪求欢畅而出去欣赏，才是罪过。

en.t: As for the light of the sun and moon, it would be a fault only if you went out to admire it from a selfish craving for pleasure.

units.source_text: 你们如此待我，使我十分难堪。

en.t: When you treat me in this way, you put me in great discomfort.

units.source_text: 我还想探询小姐胸中悲哀之状而设法安慰呢。”

en.t: I had hoped to ask about the sorrow in your hearts and try somehow to comfort you."

units.source_text: 侍女们说：“果然不错，我家小姐的悲哀深切无比。

en.t: The gentlewomen said, "Indeed, it is just as you say; our ladies' grief is deeper than words can measure.

units.source_text: 承蒙设法安慰，美意实在不浅啊！”

en.t: That you should take such pains to comfort them shows truly profound kindness."

units.source_text: 虽然只经过这淡然的几句谈话，但大女公子心情也逐渐平静起来，能理解薰君的好意了。

en.t: Although only these few quiet words had been exchanged, the elder princess's feelings gradually calmed, and she came to understand Lord Kaoru's good intentions.

units.source_text: 她设想薰君即使只为对父亲的旧交情而来，如此不惮跋涉之劳，远道来访，好意也良可感谢。

en.t: She thought that even if Lord Kaoru had come only out of old friendship with her father, his kindness in making the long journey without minding the hardship was deeply worthy of gratitude.

units.source_text: 因此膝行而出，与薰君稍稍接近。

en.t: She therefore shuffled forward on her knees and drew a little closer to Lord Kaoru.

units.source_text: 薰君慰问她们的哀思，又叙述对八亲王的誓约，语言非常诚恳亲切。

en.t: Lord Kaoru comforted them in their sorrow and spoke of his vow to the Eighth Prince, his words deeply sincere and kind.

units.source_text: 原来薰君没有雄赳赳、气昂昂的态度，故大女公子对之不觉得严肃可怕。

en.t: Since Lord Kaoru had no swaggering or overbearing manner, the elder princess did not find him stern or frightening.

units.source_text: 然而想起了今天不得不和这不相识的男子亲口谈话，并且今后将仰仗他的照顾，

en.t: Yet when she thought that today she had been forced to speak directly with this unfamiliar man, and that from now on she would have to rely on his care,

units.source_text: 和过去的情况比较之下，毕竟不胜伤心失意。

en.t: she could not help feeling grief and despair when she compared it with how things had been before.

units.source_text: 她只是轻言细语地回答了一二句话，那意气消沉、萎靡不振之状，使得薰君异常怜悯。

en.t: She answered only a word or two in a soft voice, and her dejected, listless state filled Lord Kaoru with extraordinary pity.

units.source_text: 他从黑色帷屏的隙间窥看，但见大女公子神色非常痛苦。

en.t: He peered through a gap in the black curtain screen and saw that the elder princess looked deeply distressed.

units.source_text: 想象她孤居寂处之状，又回思那年黎明时分窥见姿色时的光景，便自言自语地吟诗曰：

en.t: Imagining how she lived alone in such desolation, and recalling the dawn when he had once glimpsed her beauty, he murmured a poem to himself:
